main.description: Proxies an image from a link embed through the AppView, so the viewer's address never reaches the origin. The URL comes signed in an embed view, which lets an img element load it without a bearer header. The origin's content type must be an allowed image type. Supports HTTP range requests.

exp.description: Unix time in seconds after which the link stops working.

sig.description: Signature over the kind, url and exp, issued by this AppView.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: url, exp or sig is missing or malformed.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The signature is invalid or expired.

errors.name: NotFetchable
errors.description: The origin could not be reached or answered with an error.

errors.name: UnsupportedImage
errors.description: The origin served something other than an allowed image type.
